paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.65% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.33%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-1.34%). Brent crude changed -0.83% to 90.64. Gold changed +1.17% to 3,603.3999. Bitcoin changed +1.58% to 60,688.8516. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.848%, a relative move of -1.14%. Among the firms tracked, Glencore (-4.79%) and Vale (+4.70%) moved the most.
